result.description: Attio is a CRM and revenue platform with AI agents, workflows, and a public REST API and MCP server.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code (PKCE for user-level tokens) for multi-workspace apps; per-workspace API key created in developer settings. Both sent as Authorization: Bearer token.
result.access_detail: Free plan (3 users) shows API and webhooks, MCP and App SDK rows with no restriction (extracted text; inferred). Each user can self-create a workspace API key, so no review gate on that path. OAuth app is unreviewed up to 25 workspaces, with a warning shown at install. Beyond 25, or to remove the warning, the app must be published and Attio review takes up to 1 week. REST API public apps are listed as needing review.
result.api_notes: Public REST API with JSON over HTTPS, plus webhooks and an App SDK. The hosted MCP server's tools show data coverage: objects, records, lists, notes, tasks, meetings, call recordings, emails, comments and more. SQL access via API and MCP is Ultra-only. I did not fetch the endpoint reference, so breadth is inferred from the MCP tool list.
result.blocker: A multi-tenant OAuth toolkit needs Attio publication review (up to 1 week) to go past 25 workspaces and drop the unapproved-app warning. The API-key path has no such gate.

evidence.quote: Attio implements the standard OAuth 2.0 specification, using the Authorization Code Grant Flow
If you only need a token for a single workspace, you can generate an API key in the developer settings page of your apps.
An unpublished app can be installed in up to 25 workspaces.
Publishing requires a review from the Attio team, which can take up to 1 week.
Yes. The Free plan costs nothing for up to three users.
Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
Attio MCP is Attio's hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace.
Every plan includes the Attio MCP server, which connects AI tools that support the Model Context Protocol, such as Claude and ChatGPT, to your workspace.
To remove these warnings and the installation limit, submit your app for review.
